privacy.ai_training_note: Miro's AI Trust page states plainly: 'Your data is never used to train Miro AI models.' AI features are powered by third-party model subprocessors (Anthropic listed for AI Functionality, US; Microsoft referenced in the privacy policy: 'the AI features may share limited data with Microsoft in connection with the use of the AI features and to monitor compliance with codes of conduct'). Enterprise admins get granular AI controls: block AI/MCP on sensitive boards, native prompt-redaction, custom AI terms-of-service banners, AI-vs-human content attribution logs, and the option to bring their own model API key. Governed under ISO/IEC 42001.
privacy.data_region: Data residency available in EU, US, Australia (AUS), and Japan. AWS is the primary infrastructure subprocessor (US default, residency available for AUS/EU/US).

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Yes - third-party pen testing; 'Miro Penetration Test Summary 2025-2026' available for request in the Trust Center.

security.name: Bug bounty / vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Yes - public bug bounty program on HackerOne (hackerone.com/miro). Trust Center also provides a 'Report a vulnerability' channel and security@miro.com contact.

security.name: Access control
security.value: MFA for all systems, role-based access control, SSO integration, just-in-time privileged access, automated/biannual access reviews, account lockout and session timeout.

security.name: AI governance controls
security.value: ISO 42001 management system, admin control over AI features, AI activity audit logging, AI data handling and training restrictions, built-in prompt redaction and moderation, ongoing surveillance audits.

security.name: Operational security
security.value: Annual + semi-annual risk assessments, formal security policies, incident response plan with post-incident root cause analysis, internal security audits/monitoring, cybersecurity insurance.

security.name: Enterprise Guard
security.value: Optional advanced data-governance add-on: sensitive data discovery/classification, content lifecycle management, legal discovery and preservation. Uses Google LLC as subprocessor for sensitive data discovery.

security.name: Security whitepaper
security.value: Downloadable security & compliance whitepaper covering infrastructure, operational, and product security layers.

products.name: Miro Free / individual plan
products.data_scope: Personal account data + Customer Content on boards. Subject to standard Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. AI features available but enterprise admin governance controls not present.
products.notes: Entry tier; no contractual data-residency selection.

products.name: Miro Business / Team plans
products.data_scope: Organization-controlled Customer Content; billing data collected. DPA available. Standard SOC 2 / ISO 27001 covered services.
products.notes: Org admin controls; covered by Master Cloud Agreement / Customer DPA.

products.name: Miro Enterprise
products.data_scope: Data residency selection (EU/US/AUS/Japan), SSO, advanced AI governance (prompt redaction, AI scope blocking, attribution logs, BYO model API key).
products.notes: Full enterprise security and compliance posture; targets security-conscious enterprises (Accenture, Deloitte, CVS Health, PepsiCo, Microsoft listed as customers).

products.name: Enterprise Guard (add-on)
products.data_scope: Sensitive-data discovery and classification, lifecycle management, legal hold/eDiscovery. Adds Google LLC as a subprocessor for sensitive data discovery.
products.notes: Optional advanced governance layer on top of Enterprise.

products.name: Miro AI features
products.data_scope: AI interaction data is part of Services Data. Powered by third-party models (Anthropic, Microsoft). Customer data is NOT used to train Miro AI models. Governed by ISO 42001 and separate AI Terms.
products.notes: Distinct AI Terms in legal hub; data shared with model subprocessors only to deliver the feature.

products.name: Miro Developer Platform / MCP
products.data_scope: Governed by Developer Terms of Use and Marketplace Terms. Third-Party Services may exchange Customer Content per customer-granted permissions.
products.notes: 250+ apps and integrations; MCP connector support for agentic workflows.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS - Free tier plus paid Business, Enterprise, and add-ons (Enterprise Guard); education/startup/NPO programs.
compare.data_residency: EU, US, Australia, Japan (selectable on Enterprise)
